# Alembic migrations

Async config that pulls the database URL from `jyry.config.get_settings()`,
so `DATABASE_URL` in `.env` is the single source of truth.

```bash
# Apply all pending migrations
alembic upgrade head

# Create a new autogenerated revision after editing models
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "describe the change"

# Roll back one revision
alembic downgrade -1
```

Constraint names follow the project's naming convention
(`pk_*`, `uq_*`, `ix_*`, `fk_*_*_*`, `ck_*_*`) defined in `jyry/db/base.py`,
so autogenerated diffs stay stable across machines.
